scope: deterministic synthetic fixture suite for the Chromium MV3 weekend MVP
limitations: These are deterministic safety-gate fixtures, not model accuracy, field recall, browser parity, or universal privacy results.
The extension is DOM-first and masks visible media wholesale; no OCR, face detector, VLM, or remote planner is bundled.
Latency and resource p95 measurements require a frozen-device benchmark run before portal submission.
